name: Chase Sapphire Preferred Card

intro_offer.headline: 60,000 bonus points
intro_offer.spend_requirement: $4,000 in purchases in the first 3 months

rewards.on: dining, select streaming services, and online grocery purchases

regular_apr: 20.99% to 27.99% variable, depending on your credit
rating_reason: The 60,000-point welcome offer alone covers the $95 annual fee for several years. No foreign transaction fee and solid travel protections make it a strong first travel card.
best_for: people who travel a few times a year and eat out regularly
skip_if: you rarely travel or redeem points; the $95 fee is hard to justify without using the travel benefits
